title: Pipeline evidence record, version 1
description: One pipeline step or event, as any component of the development pipeline records it. One record per JSON line in a .jsonl file. The format is versioned: a consumer that meets a version it does not know refuses instead of guessing. See docs/pi/pipeline-evidence.md.

version.description: The record format's version. This file describes version 1.

component.description: The program that produced the record, named as its own command is: board, mq, gate.

stage.description: Which pipeline stage the step belongs to, from the shared vocabulary.

step.description: The producing component's own name for the step within the stage, such as a gate check kind or a merge queue stage.

wait.description: True when the record measures time spent waiting rather than working. Optional; absent means false.

subject.description: What the step was about. All four keys are present; the ones that do not apply are null, and at least one names something.

repository.description: The repository the work belongs to: its remote URL when it has one, otherwise the absolute path of its root.

commit.description: A git commit sha the step read, produced or judged: the landed sha, the gate's HEAD, the candidate.

item.description: The board item the work belongs to, when the component knows it.

run.description: The producing component's own name for the run the step belongs to: a claim name, a gate run, a board run id.

startedAt.description: When the step began, UTC, ISO-8601, ending in Z.

endedAt.description: When the step ended, UTC, ISO-8601, ending in Z. Never earlier than startedAt.

durationMs.description: The producer's own measurement of the step's duration in milliseconds. Authoritative: timestamps order records, this number is the cost.

outcome.description: The step's result in the shared vocabulary. A producer's finer word goes in detail.

detail.description: Free-form object. Nothing validates its contents, so a producer may add what its own readers need.
